import html # Example HTML template for a blog post. # The placeholders {title} and {body} will be replaced by the # sanitized user inputs. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def render_article_page(headline: str, content: str) -> str: """ Render a user‑submitted blog post safely for display on a webpage. Parameters ---------- headline : str The title or headline of the blog post. content : str The full text body of the blog post. Returns ------- str A sanitized HTML string containing the rendered blog post. """ # Sanitize user input to prevent XSS and injection attacks. safe_headline = html.escape(headline, quote=True) # For the content we escape all HTML characters but also preserve # line breaks by converting them to
tags. This keeps the text # readable while preventing malicious markup. safe_content = html.escape(content, quote=True).replace("\n", "
") # Insert the sanitized values into the template. rendered = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_headline, body=safe_content) return rendered
